Role Overview

CookieYes publishes a large library of privacy content that businesses worldwide rely on to understand legal requirements. We need a professionally qualified law graduate who writes because they love it, not just to meet a brief. You will track privacy legislation across jurisdictions, translate it into actionable content, and serve as the internal check on the legal accuracy of everything we publish and ship. The role also involves genuine legal work: reviewing our agreements, supporting compliance queries, and keeping product claims defensible.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor global privacy and data‑protection developments (GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA, US state laws, LGPD, PIPEDA, PDPA, emerging regulations) and flag relevant changes for CookieYes and its customers.
  • Write authoritative long‑form content: regulation explainers, jurisdiction guides, compliance checklists, legal update posts, and whitepapers.
  • Act as the legal‑accuracy reviewer for marketing and product content, adhering to an agreed turnaround SLA so reviews never stall the pipeline.
  • Structure content for AI search, AI Overviews, and answer engines; collaborate with SEO and AI teams on generative‑engine optimisation, schema, and citation‑worthy formatting.
  • Translate regulatory obligations into product requirements, working with product and engineering on consent, records, and disclosures.
  • Support customer‑facing compliance queries escalated by sales and support; build internal reference material to reduce escalations.
  • Review and maintain our legal documents (privacy policy, terms of service, DPAs, vendor agreements) with external counsel as needed.
  • Prepare briefing notes for leadership when regulatory changes affect roadmap or positioning.
  • Represent CookieYes publicly through bylined articles, webinars, and industry commentary.

Requirements

  • LLB or equivalent law degree from a recognised institution; bar council enrolment welcome but not required.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in a law firm, in‑house legal team, compliance function, or legal publishing role.
  • Demonstrable writing ability for non‑lawyer audiences (publish work, blog, newsletter, or substantial piece).
  • Ability to write for business owners, delivering accuracy without legalese.
  • Working familiarity with data‑protection law, or clear evidence you can master a regulatory area quickly.
  • Fluency with AI tools for research, drafting, and summarisation, paired with disciplined verification of every citation.
  • Strong research discipline: cite primary sources, check for superseded guidance, avoid building arguments on secondary summaries.
  • Sound judgement on the line between explaining law and giving legal advice.

Good to Have

  • Privacy certification (CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM) or intent to pursue one (support provided).
  • Prior experience at a SaaS, privacy‑tech, or legal‑tech company.
  • Experience drafting or negotiating DPAs and SaaS agreements.

  • Deep understanding of major global privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, DPA, PDPA, UCPA, etc.).

A growing share of people needing a consent management platform now ask an AI assistant instead of a search engine. They ask ChatGPT how to comply with GDPR, they ask Claude to add a cookie banner to the site it just built, and they read an AI Overview instead of clicking a result. CookieYes intends to be the answer in those places.

Role Overview

This role has two halves: AI search visibility – getting CookieYes recommended, cited and integrated across LLM surfaces – and agentic automation – building AI workflows that let a small growth team operate like a much larger one. We need a hands‑on practitioner for both.

Responsibilities

  • Own CookieYes’s visibility in AI search: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews. Define metrics and improve them.
  • Build the measurement layer for LLM visibility: prompt sets, share‑of‑voice tracking, citation monitoring, competitor benchmarking.
  • Run generative engine optimisation: content structure, entity and schema markup, extractable formatting, freshness signals.
  • Identify third‑party sources LLMs cite and work with content, PR and partnerships to earn placements.
  • Collaborate with product and partnerships on distribution inside AI ecosystems (MCP servers, connector directories, plugin marketplaces, AI website builder integrations).
  • Build agentic workflows for the growth team: competitor/regulation monitoring, content research & briefing pipelines, review & approval flows, reporting automation, internal tooling.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tooling across the growth stack, setting guardrails for automation vs. human review and output quality checks.
  • Maintain traditional SEO fundamentals: technical health, internal linking, topical authority, Core Web Vitals.
  • Report on AI‑sourced traffic, assisted sign‑ups and share of voice, clearly communicating what works and what is noise.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in SEO, content strategy or growth engineering with recent work on AI search, GEO, AEO or LLM visibility.
  • Hands‑on experience building agentic workflows/automations using n8n, Zapier, Make, LangChain, or direct API/MCP integrations.
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering and LLM behaviour (retrieval, grounding, citation patterns, hallucinations).
  • Solid technical SEO foundation: crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture, Core Web Vitals.
  • Ability to write scripts in Python or JavaScript for API calls, parsing results, and monitoring jobs.

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior growth leader to own the full customer lifecycle – acquisition, onboarding, engagement and retention – for a SaaS business >$10M ARR. You will write the growth plan, control the budget, build a small specialist team, and deliver weekly results on shipped experiments.

Responsibilities

  • Growth Plan & Execution: Set quarterly targets across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention; sequence work and ship it.
  • End‑to‑End Metrics: Own sign‑ups, activation, free‑to‑paid conversion, cohort retention, churn, expansion revenue, CAC payback.
  • Acquisition: Lead organic, paid, product‑led, AI search and marketplace channels; allocate budget each quarter.
  • Onboarding: Optimize the path from install to live consent banner; reduce drop‑off and deliver first value quickly.
  • Engagement: Build lifecycle programs via email, in‑app messaging and product prompts.
  • Retention & Churn: Track cohort retention, diagnose attrition, run win‑back/reactivation, implement product/support fixes.
  • Expansion: Drive upgrades, usage‑based triggers, pricing and packaging tests with product & finance.
  • Experimentation Roadmap: Run tests on website, onboarding, pricing page, in‑app upgrade paths and lifecycle email.
  • Growth Reporting: Define key metrics, instrument them, and make data legible for the wider team.
  • Partnerships: Align with Global Partnerships & Affiliate teams to reinforce channel growth.
  • Team Management: Mentor a small team of performance, lifecycle, SEO and AI‑search specialists; hire as needed.
  • Budget Ownership: Allocate and defend paid spend; reallocate based on data.
  • Weekly Review: Present shipped work, results, and decisions on what to kill.

Ownership & Ways of Working

  • You own the numbers; you decide and act when growth lags.
  • High experiment velocity is expected – ten tests, six failures is better than two shipped quarterly.
  • No backlog handed to you; you identify constraints and act.
  • Decisions are data‑driven, not data‑wishful.
  • Real budget authority comes with honest reporting.
  • Small, flat team with direct leadership access; no permission‑seeking.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in growth, performance or product marketing with direct ownership at a B2B SaaS >$10M ARR.
  • Proven record of moving company‑level numbers (acquisition, onboarding, retention, expansion).
  • Experience managing a substantial paid acquisition budget and cutting spend when ROI falters.
  • Track record of high‑volume experimentation and rapid kill of losers.
  • Ability to translate a growth plan into a sequenced quarterly roadmap.
  • Strong funnel and cohort analytics skills; proficient in GA4, Mixpanel or Amplitude.
  • Hands‑on paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn.
  • Working knowledge of SEO and content‑led acquisition.
  • Experience building lifecycle/in‑product messaging (HubSpot, Customer.io, Intercom, etc.).
  • Statistical literacy for valid testing.
  • Experience hiring, managing and holding a small team accountable.
  • Self‑directed and comfortable operating without close supervision.

Good to Have

  • Experience with freemium or open‑source models (e.g., WordPress plugins).
  • Exposure to privacy, compliance, security or developer tooling markets.
  • Experience in product‑led businesses with partner/marketplace channels.
  • Familiarity with AI assistants, AI Overviews and LLM‑driven discovery/search.
